summary: New Wave is a Mermaid Beach, Gold Coast firm led by Reuben Bergola (CEO / Managing Partner) with a large ecommerce client base and A2X-based settlement reconciliation. Since 2026 Reuben has publicly rebuilt the firm around AI, with over 40 internal tools including a bank-feed coding agent, and coaches other firms through the Empwr Firms podcast and program. This is a likely build-it-yourself prospect, so outreach should be peer-level and focused on payout/settlement reconciliation.

followUp.subject: Re: Quick chat, Reuben?
followUp.body:
Hi Reuben, I read the Empwr Firms episode on your 6am agent that codes bank feeds before the team arrives. Coding is the volume part. With 195+ ecommerce and retail clients, are the Shopify and Amazon payouts sitting in clearing accounts also handled by an agent, or still by bookkeepers? That settlement side is what Vert is built for, and I'd value your read.

Best,
Dawoud
Vert | https://vertfinance.tech

followUp2.body:
Hi Reuben, last nudge from me. Your Open Door Test asks whether a tool can write, not just read. I'd like to show Vert reconciling one ecommerce client file in Xero, with a trail you can trace, and let you judge it on your own terms. Ten minutes, and you can tell me if your tools already cover it.
